CoverageDimension.description:
One narrative dimension (HYBRID). label/purpose are CreativeIntent-derived
and Story-specific; `coverage` is categorical. `id` is a handle WITHIN THIS
snapshot only — do NOT key persistent state on it, do NOT expect it stable
across recomputes (semantic drift is expected).

id.description: within-snapshot handle ONLY; not durable identity
id.title: Id

purpose.description: what this dimension expresses for the Story
purpose.title: Purpose

CoverageDimension.title: CoverageDimension

CoverageStoryIdea.description:
ONE optional high-level narrative opportunity. NOT scene-specific, NOT
camera direction. The whole object is nullable at StoryCoverage.story_idea —
null is a first-class correct result (no interruption).
CoverageStoryIdea.title: CoverageStoryIdea

NarrativeCoverage.description: Advisory, internal only — never rendered as a progress bar (02 §8).
NarrativeCoverage.title: NarrativeCoverage

SufficiencyStatus.description:
Can a Story meeting the user's intent be made from the understood material?
Relative to CreativeIntent + scope + complementarity + redundancy + pending
uncertainty — NEVER derived from Moment count.
SufficiencyStatus.title: SufficiencyStatus

pending_count.title: Pending Count

source_understanding_ids.description: which MomentUnderstanding records this was computed from (staleness/provenance)
source_understanding_ids.title: Source Understanding Ids
